{{MultipleIssues|image|expand}}
An '''advanced targeting computer''' was an improved version of the [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]]. At least one example of such was installed on the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] starfighters.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
The Alliance to Restore the Republic starfighter unit [[Red Squadron]] managed to procure some advanced targeting computers during their mission to [[Defense of Ralltiir|save]] several Rebel-sympathizing scientists on the planet from Imperial subjugation, after destroying an Imperial transport.
{{Endgame}}

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During the final legs of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Gold Leader [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], while infiltrating the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] superstructure alongside Red Squadron and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], noticed some advanced targeting computer specs within one of the pipes, procuring it in the process.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Advanced targeting computers were a tech upgrade in the ''Rogue Squadron'' series. Gaining it will result in the player being capable of keeping the targeting computer on without having to hold down the targeting computer button.
